framework: SFDA MDS-G010 Guidance on AI and ML technologies based Medical Devices (v1.0, 29/11/2022)
requirement_paraphrase: Where independent review is needed, the clinical evaluation should as far as possible be reviewed by someone not significantly involved in development and with nothing to gain, proportionate to risk; an evaluation based on a comparator device must show clinical and technical equivalence including the algorithm.
what_is_tested: Independence of clinical evaluation review; equivalence claims

framework: NCA 'Draft of AI Cybersecurity Guidelines' (AICG-1:2026), draft for public consultation (closed 5 Aug 2026)
requirement_paraphrase: When a vulnerability is detected, disable or restrict vulnerable AI features until remediation is validated.

framework: SDAIA Generative AI Guidelines for the Public (2025)
clause_or_page: Fairness principle, developers and users should
requirement_paraphrase: Developers and users should carefully test GenAI models to ensure no bias has been embedded in code or algorithms.

framework: Canada - Directive on Automated Decision-Making (TBS, amended 2025-06-24)
requirement_paraphrase: Obtain and safeguard all released versions of software components; document decisions and assessments made or assisted by the system in support of testing, monitoring, data governance and reporting.
what_is_tested: Reproducibility and audit trail for testing and monitoring

framework: Canada - Directive on Automated Decision-Making (TBS, amended 2025-06-24)
requirement_paraphrase: Systems developed or procured after 2020-04-01 must comply; existing systems developed/procured before 2025-06-24 had until 2026-06-24 to comply with new or updated requirements.

framework: DoH Abu Dhabi Policy on Use of AI in the Healthcare Sector (Policy/AI/0.9, 30 Apr 2018)
requirement_paraphrase: DoH expects AI tools introduced in Abu Dhabi for healthcare delivery, public health, pharmaceutical production and medical research to be robust, evidenced by certification of the AI software (and of major upgraded versions) from recognised international agencies, compliance with ADSSSA regulations, and auditable validation statements.
what_is_tested: Software certification, regulatory compliance and validation statements
who_tests: Recognised international certification agencies; technology provider (validation statement)

framework: Canada - Directive on Automated Decision-Making (TBS, amended 2025-06-24)
requirement_paraphrase: Before the system is in production, test the data, information and underlying model for accuracy, unintended biases, and any factors that could unintentionally or unfairly affect outcomes or violate human rights and freedoms.
what_is_tested: Pre-production accuracy and bias testing of data, information and model; human-rights impact factors
who_tests: The department's responsible ADM/senior official (self-assessed); no independent tester required except peer review at impact level II+

clause_or_page: Scope of Work and Applicability, p. 8
requirement_paraphrase: States the guidelines are advisory and not mandatory, recommended to every Saudi entity that uses or plans to use AI systems as minimum cybersecurity good practice.
Recommends structured risk assessments across all use cases before adopting any AI system, aligned with an SDAIA AI Risk Assessment Framework, with results documented in dashboards.
what_is_tested: Safety, fairness and regulatory-compliance risks of use cases

framework: Canada - Directive on Automated Decision-Making (TBS, amended 2025-06-24)
clause_or_page: s.6.3.7; Appendix C (Peer review), levels II and III
requirement_paraphrase: At impact level II and III, consult at least one qualified expert reviewer (federal/provincial/territorial/municipal government expert, post-secondary faculty, relevant NGO researcher, contracted third-party vendor with relevant specialisation, or a TBS-specified advisory board) to review the system, AIA and documentation, and publish the full review or a plain-language summary before production. Level I: none.
what_is_tested: Independent expert review of the system, AIA and supporting documentation
who_tests: External or cross-government qualified expert (department chooses from the listed categories)
